findings.reason: a node has two incompatible readings, either pasting the state at the 46 promoted nodes (which makes clause 1's equality a copy rather than an evaluation and leaves a discontinuous drawn field, exactly the artefact the display map exists to remove) or evaluating the imaged field (which fails clauses 1 and 2 by about 2.8e-2 Wb against a bound of ten residual, about 6% of the 0.46 Wb level band), and the plan settles neither.
findings.text: §9 defines the map the solve iterates as `flux_map` plus the constrained rows' `flux_delta` and requires the display map to be "the continuation of that map to the display points"; but that map's trip boundary is `mapped = jnp.where(promoted, state, image)` (nova/equilibrium/reduced_newton.py:976), a per-node paste of the trial state over the residual-shadow nodes, which the fragment §9 cites as its diagnosis measures as the largest component of the state gap (2.786e-02 Wb on the converged edit, against 2.405e-03 Wb for the compensating flux)

findings.reason: the node that must implement §9 cannot open the diagnosis it is told to build from, and the 2.4 mWb / 4.6 mWb premise cannot be checked before the code is written.
findings.text: §9 rests its root cause on "the coil-edit node's diagnosis (fragment `coil-edit-fine-panels`)" and on per-figure `panel-receipt.json` files, but `docs/evidence/fragments/separatrix-spline-extraction/coil-edit-fine-panels.html` exists only in commits 1f1391bd0, b5e324c0a and 131f313f4, none of which is an ancestor of main HEAD, and `git ls-tree -r HEAD | grep panel-receipt.json` returns nothing, so neither the fragment nor those receipts are in the tree a node will work in

findings.reason: a node can satisfy §9's gate and then satisfy §6/§7's own gates while the constraint compensation is still never persisted, drawing the same map §9 exists to reject, so the mechanism would land and reach no corrected figure.
findings.text: §9's body requires that "the builder therefore takes the terminal state vector and the constraint compensation as inputs, and producers persist both", while §9's three clauses gate only the builder and a state the test itself produces, and the dependent producers' gates (§6 done-when 2, §7 done-when 2) still enumerate the state archives as carrying "the conductor currents and cell moments" only

findings.reason: §5 is already done, so no dispatch order changes, and the receipt line §9 replaces is a one-line edit the section already names.
findings.text: §9 declares `data-links="separatrix-spline-extraction#s5"` and changes §5's builder contract ("that equality replaces the `raster_image` reproduction in the receipt"), yet the section-depends-on map declares only s6/s7/s8 → s9 and no s9 → s5, while §5 stays declared done with a done-when that still asserts the `raster_image` reproduction

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — the fragment §9 cites for its diagnosis, and every panel receipt beside the figures, are unreachable from the primary branch.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §9 requires the terminal state vector and the constrained rows' compensation to be persisted, but no clause of its own gate, nor §6's or §7's, measures that persistence.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the gate artefacts §9 points at would live under docs/figures/… with the figures, not in a scratch or node-local path; their reachability is reported under anchors_resolve.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §9's symbols (`build_display_flux_map`, `max_node_mismatch_wb`, `flux_delta`) name mechanisms, and no plan label, stage name or ticket number reaches code.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the stated root cause matches the cited diagnosis, but the mechanism §9 specifies treats a node-wise shadow pass-through as a term a display map can carry off the lattice, which the cited evidence measures as the largest part of the gap.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §9 carries one goal, making the display map the map the reduced solve iterates, and its three clauses are one gate on that goal.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — §9 consumes §5's builder and supersedes part of its receipt, but the section-depends-on map carries only s6/s7/s8 → s9 and no s9 → s5 edge.
